title: Require release manifest file inventory
summary: The alpha release bundle manifest now records digests for scaffolded files, but the validator should also reject extra bundle files that are not listed in the manifest. Require the manifest inventory to match the bundle's regular files so future provenance or artifact files cannot be added without digest coverage.
expectedFailureModes: A release bundle gains an extra file after review without any manifest digest.
Recursive bundle files are skipped because only top-level scaffold files are inventoried.
The validator accepts unsafe or non-portable manifest paths while checking inventory coverage.
nextAction: Teach the bundle validator to compare manifest entries with the bundle file inventory, generate recursive relative paths, document the exact coverage rule, and add regression coverage for an unmanifested file.
